summary: Reproduced at 28b09f96df75. Converting a tiny Qwen2ForCausalLM whose q/k/v projections have biases failed during the converter's own forward pass over the quantized module with RuntimeError 'Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, cuda:0 and cpu!' at exllamav3/modules/quant/exl3.py:98 (the converted LinearEXL3 adding its CPU-resident bias to a CUDA output).

limits: Synthetic weights. Observed inside conversion's state-advance forward; a separately loaded converted model was not run.
